title: Agent Sandbox Pod Roadmap
goal: Run agent code, browser and test jobs in a disposable Podman sandbox pod with scoped mounts, no default secrets and audited artifacts.

slice_queue.goal: Define sandbox job request, policy decision, artifact manifest and audit model.
Render safe Podman pod/container command plans without executing them.
Define worker API for submit/status/artifacts/cancel with redacted responses.

slice_queue.evidence: Debian live smoke on 2026-07-02: disposable Podman pod with network none, Python entrypoint, memory/cpu/pids/no-new-privileges limits returned Python 3.14.6.
slice_queue.goal: Create a disposable sandbox pod and run a harmless argv command plus artifact collection.

done_definition: No job can access host paths outside declared mounts.
No job gets secrets unless explicitly attached.
Every command has timeout, output cap and artifact cap.
Job output is redacted before entering chat or memory.
Podman plans are reviewable before live execution.
